rooms.name: Immortal Map Room
rooms.desc: Look map to see slums layout.

rooms.name: Entering a Dim Street
rooms.desc:
While most city streets are clean and well maintained, the street here
has taken a turn for the worse. Looking ahead, you can see that the street
doesn't get any better, worse in fact. There is a sign fastened securely
to the wall of a building.

rooms.name: A Dim Street
rooms.desc:
Proceeding deeper into the slums, the street narrows and begins to
twist and turn. Rubbish lies strewn about randomly, sometimes threatening
to topple down upon you. It would be easy to get lost here.

rooms.name: A Dim Street
rooms.desc:
It is said that this section is the oldest part of town. It certainly
looks like it now. Poorly constructed houses line the street, sometimes
two stories high, and garbage is a continual threat to life.

rooms.name: A Blocked Street
rooms.desc:
As the road continues, little changes beside the direction you are 
going.  Ahead, the burnt remains of a building are piled in the street
blocking your way south. From all appearances, houses have been built
haphazardly upon the ruined foundations of others.

rooms.name: In a Ruined Building
rooms.desc:
Charred bricks and wood lay scattered about in small pieces. It feels
weird walking through the remains of this building.  You wonder what caused
the fire and more importantly why it didn't consume this entire section of
town.

rooms.name: In a Ruined Building
rooms.desc:
This building apparently had a basement judging by the hollow thunk of
your boots on the floorboards. Or maybe it's the creak of the rotting
floorboards.  Best not to dally too long.

rooms.name: A Clean Street
rooms.desc:
The street here is clean, meticulously swept by someone. There is no sign
of rubbish anywhere.  There is a light to the south.

rooms.name: A Clean Street
rooms.desc:
Like the street to the north, this area has been swept clean and there
is a lantern hanging from a lamp post. To the east is the entrance of some
sort of establishment.

rooms.name: The Plated Ingot
rooms.desc:
In direct contrast to the rest of this part of the city, this room is 
clean, warm, and well lit. The lighting is provided by what appears to be
magical globes hung on chandeliers. On the north wall is a fireplace that
blazes heartily.  To your right, a bar lies along the west wall.  Across
many tables and clouds of pipe and other smoke is a doorway through which
you can hear occasional snatches of conversation. The bar continues south.

rooms.name: The Plated Ingot
rooms.desc:
Most of the people in the tavern have congregated in this end of the
room. The lighting here is a bit dimmer. Given the nature of this part
of the town, you would expect the patrons to be more wary, yet most look
fairly relaxed. The bar along the west wall is made of sturdy ironwood 
from the surrounding forests of Kir Drax'in. Behind the bar is a doorway
through which the smells of fine foods waft. On the east side of the room
is a closed door. Along the south wall a set of stairs leads up.

rooms.name: The Kitchen
rooms.desc:
As you guessed, this is the kitchen. Pots and pans hang from the ceiling.
Various kettles sit bubbling jovially upon fire pits which line north and
south walls. In the center of the room is a large preparation table upon
which a huge slab of spiced meat lies steaming. On the west wall is a medium-
sized hole with shutters on either side.

rooms.name: Gambling room
rooms.desc:
Low-hung, dim lights hang over assorted small gambling tables. You can
see a variety of card games going on, a game of sherpa, as well as several
dice games. It's hard to make out any faces in the crowd due to the precise
positioning of the lighting in addition to the volume of smoke. The little
conversation you hear seems sporadic and muted, with only occasional rowdy
outbursts.

rooms.name: Conference Room
rooms.desc:
A long table surrounded by high-back wing chairs takes up most of this
room. Along the walls are narrow tables laden with food and drink. The
combination of dim lighting and dark paneling makes identification of
people difficult.

rooms.name: Madame Isabel's
rooms.desc:
This room takes on an entirely different feel.  Soft couches and plush
chairs line the walls and fill the floor. Several books rest upon end tables.
To the west, north, and east are rooms cordoned off by silken walls.

rooms.name: Silk Partitioned Room
rooms.desc:
Silk partitioning has divided this room into many sub-compartments.
Sounds of ah, well, errr, pleasure come from many of the rooms.  If
possible, the lighting here is even dimmer.

rooms.name: Silk Partitioned Room
rooms.desc:
Silk partitioning has divided this room into many sub-compartments.
Sounds of ah, well, errr, pleasure come from many of the rooms.  If
possible, the lighting here is even dimmer.

rooms.name: Silk Partitioned Room
rooms.desc:
Silk partitioning has divided this room into many sub-compartments.
Sounds of ah, well, errr, pleasure come from many of the rooms.  If
possible, the lighting here is even dimmer.

rooms.name: Private Quarters
rooms.desc:
Bookshelves line the walls of this room and several layers of rugs
cover most of the floor. Along the east wall is all sorts of experimental
magic paraphernalia. A soft feather bed occupies the northwest corner and
an over-stuffed wingback chair sits beside an end table in the center of
the room. A small dining table sits against the south wall.  A narrow 
staircase leads upwards.

rooms.name: Rooftop
rooms.desc:
You stand upon the rooftop of the Plated Ingot. Long, low chairs are
scattered about the roof as well as several strange instruments.  A low
wall protects you from stumbling off the edge to the street below.
Scattered about the roof are several plants of unknown variety. There
appears to be some sort of force field just above this area.

rooms.name: Rooftop
rooms.desc:
You stand upon the rooftop of the Plated Ingot. A low wall protects
you from stumbling off the edge to the street below.  Scattered about
the roof are several plants of unknown variety.

rooms.name: Rooftop
rooms.desc:
You stand upon the rooftop of the Plated Ingot. A low wall protects
you from stumbling off the edge to the street below.  Scattered about
the roof are several plants of unknown variety.

rooms.name: Rooftop
rooms.desc:
You stand upon the rooftop of the Plated Ingot. A low wall protects
you from stumbling off the edge to the street below.  Scattered about
the roof are several plants of unknown variety.

rooms.name: A Clean Street
rooms.desc:
Like the street to the west, the way here is clear of debris.  It has
been swept clean by someone.

rooms.name: A Dim Street
rooms.desc:
The street here has reverted to the filth strewn path you have seen
elsewhere. Shadows are long and buildings tower around and over you, 
many hanging almost unbelievably over the street.  A broken wall forces
you north.

rooms.name: A Dim Street
rooms.desc:
Piles of refuse force you to wind your way through the street.  The
smells here cause you to plug your nose - difficult to do while keeping
hand on your weapon and one on your money pouch. The street cuts back 
to the east.

rooms.name: A Dim Street
rooms.desc:
The ever-present garbage persists while rats chew at the carcass of
something about the size of a dog. The light here is much darker as the
buildings seem to be growing over the street.

rooms.name: An Intersection
rooms.desc: The street diverges here and is relatively free of debris.

rooms.name: Dead End Alley
rooms.desc:
The street ends here in a huge pile of garbage.  Many sets of ferral eyes
stare at you from the darkness.

rooms.name: A Dark Street
rooms.desc:
Almost all light is blocked out by the towering buildings crowding the
street. In addition, the street has narrowed considerably, though it does
not seem as filthy.  However, for what the street lacks in refuse, it makes
up in smell. A mixture of urine, vomit, and congealed blood make even the
heartiest stomachs turn sour.

rooms.name: A Dark Street
rooms.desc:
Darkness flits about you like ghosts and footing is a bit treacherous.
Bile rises in your throat at the smells assaulting you.

rooms.name: A Dark Street
rooms.desc:
The street ends here in almost complete and utter darkness.  Dark
doorways yawn insolently around you.

rooms.name: A Dark Street
rooms.desc:
Darkness drapes around you like an ill-fitting glove.  Puddles of unknown
fluids makes footing tricky.

rooms.name: A Dark Street
rooms.desc:
Light filters down more here and a bit of a breeze flushes the acidic
smell of vomit away, much to your relief. Despite the relief of being out
of the pressing darkness, you don't feel safe here. Best to move on.

rooms.name: A Dark Street
rooms.desc:
The street is cleaner here, still the ever-present refuse, but not so
much in the way of vomit and other fluids.  The east is blocked by a solid
brick wall that seems out of place here.

rooms.name: A Dark Street
rooms.desc:
You've reached the end of the street.  To the east still is the strange
brick wall and to the west is the remains of a building.

rooms.name: Ruined Building
rooms.desc:
The building here has been neatly cleared, decidedly different from the
surrounding area. To the north the building continues. To the south the way
is blocked by the remains of a brick wall. To the west there is a door with
a sign on it.

rooms.name: Ruined Building
rooms.desc:
Like the previous room, the rubble has been neatly cleaned away here.
However, it is a dead-end.  Nowhere to go.

rooms.name: A Dismal Hovel
rooms.desc:
Home to many by the appearance of this single room makeshift building.
The walls are constructed of many different materials: the floor is dirt.
Bed rolls lie scattered about the room and there is a fire pit in one corner.

rooms.desc:

rooms.name: A Pitch Black Building
rooms.desc:
If you thought the smell was bad outside, it's much worse in here.
Scattered about the room are remnants of once beautiful furniture, 
puddles of fluids and used drug paraphernalia.

rooms.name: A Pitch Black Building
rooms.desc:

Scattered about the room are remnants of once beautiful furniture,

rooms.name: An Empty Room
rooms.desc: This room is devoid of anything, including dust.

rooms.name: An Empty Room
rooms.desc: This room is devoid of anything, including dust.

rooms.name: An Empty Room
rooms.desc: This room is devoid of anything, including dust.

rooms.name: Second Floor
rooms.desc:
Despite the awful condition these two story buildings are in, it's easy
to see that they once were houses for well-to-do aristocrats.  Now they are
lotus dens, harboring those hiding behind the false security of drug-induced
stupor.

rooms.name: Narrow Plank
rooms.desc:
You teeter upon a wobbly narrow plank which spans the short distance
between buildings. Looking down into the blackness causes your gluteus
maximus to pucker, your liver to rise into your throat, and your vision
to dance a nifty number. Walk nimbly! The plank ends abruptly at a brick
wall to the west.

rooms.name: Gutted Hotel
rooms.desc:
The entire place has been gutted and turned into a lotus den. The stench
is overpowering to those with any sense left.  Of course those with any
sense wouldn't be here anyway.

rooms.name: An Empty Hovel
rooms.desc:
Once a home to many by the appearance of this single room makeshift
building.  The walls are constructed of many different materials: the
floor is dirt.  Garbage lies scattered about the room and there is a
long-neglected fire pit in one corner.

rooms.name: A Deserted Warehouse Office
rooms.desc:
A simple entry foyer with doors on opposing sides. There are several
chairs and coat hooks, and a solid utilitarian desk, but nothing else.
The entire room is covered in dust.

rooms.name: Receiving Room
rooms.desc:
Looking around at the fine furnishings and hand crafted items from all
over the world, you almost forget what where you are and what you just
traveled through to get here.

rooms.name: A Storage Room
rooms.desc:
Old crates and empty barrels lie stacked randomly about the room.  A
thick coating of dust layered over everything.  The north wall is made 
entirely of huge oaken beer aging barrels large to stand upright in.

rooms.name: A Dark Bunk room
rooms.desc: Bunks line the walls of this room. The bunks are simple wooden affairs.

rooms.name: A Training Room
rooms.desc:
Exercise equipment and practice dummies are scattered about the room.
Along the west wall is a rack of practice weapons: mostly wooden daggers,
clubs, and blackjacks, but an occasional short sword as well.

rooms.name: A Common Room
rooms.desc:
This area appears to be a common eating/cooking room.  Several food
and drink-stained tables stand near the center of the room.  The flooring
in this room consists of raised planking.  Along the north wall is a hot
fireplace and kitchen area for preparation of food.

rooms.name: Lounge/Study
rooms.desc:
Like the receiving room, this room sports fabulous items from around
the world.  Several paintings adorn the walls, statues and statuettes
are scattered here and there, and fine hand-woven rugs line the floors.
Along the north wall is a hardwood bar and nicely stocked liquor cabinet.
To the east is a heavy, carved door.

rooms.name: Master Bedroom
rooms.desc:
Opulence takes on new meaning here.  Silks and velvets cover just about
everything, including a huge four-poster canopy bed.  An armoire laden with
fine clothing rests along the east wall.  A dressing table and full-length
mirror occupies the north wall.  The huge bed consumes almost the entire
room with it's headboard against the south wall.

rooms.name: A Freshly Dug Cellar
rooms.desc:
This room appears to have been recently dug.  Touching the walls causes
dirt to crumble, cascading down into a little pile at your feet.  Probably
shouldn't do that.  Some rough timbers have been placed around the room to
attempt support.

rooms.name: A Dead-End Tunnel
rooms.desc: The tunnel ends here mysteriously.

rooms.name: A Cellar
rooms.desc:
BAM!

The stairs break as you begin to descend into the cellar. Rubbing the egg
growing on your noggin, you think "Now what am I gonna do?"

rooms.name: A Dim Street
rooms.desc:
This part of town has certainly seen better days.  Garbage is piled
everywhere without regard to sanitation. The road twists and turns lazily
between these piles.

rooms.name: A Dark Alley
rooms.desc: The way here is narrow and dark. Rather foreboding, eh?

rooms.name: Sound Room
rooms.desc: This is the sound room, if you are here, leave

rooms.name: Landing
rooms.desc:
You pause on a softly lit landing, plush carpet squishing softly beneath
your tired feet. Over the typical sounds of the bar, you can hear the softer
sounds of muted conversation above. Inhaling the air, you catch subtle scents
of perfume.
